Benefits:

• Employee discounts

• Help or transport service

At Uniqcli LLC, we combine hardware integration with software consulting to deliver secure, mission-critical solutions for the Federal Government and Enterprises. Our culture values innovation, inclusivity, and technical excellence, empowering our teams to design and deploy solutions that shape the future of digital infrastructure.

We are seeking a Part-Time Junior Web Developer (CMS – Webflow/Framer) to support the development of web platforms for internal initiatives and enterprise clients. This entry-level position is ideal for a developer looking to gain hands-on experience in Webflow and Framer while working on real client projects in a professional environment.

This role is part-time, U.S.-based, and requires legal authorization to work in the United States. Uniqcli does not sponsor visas for this position.

Responsibilities

Assist in the design, development, and maintenance of websites using Webflow and Framer.

Create and manage CMS collections, content structures, and dynamic templates. Translate design hand-offs (Figma, Adobe XD, etc.) into responsive, interactive web experiences. Test and debug websites for cross-browser compatibility and responsive behavior. Ensure compliance with WCAG 2.1 and Section 508 accessibility standards. Collaborate with senior developers and designers to deliver projects on schedule. Document workflows, content models, and CMS configurations. Contribute to iterative improvements in front-end performance and SEO.
• Learn and apply best practices in web security, accessibility, and optimization.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience)

U.S. Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (LPR).

Legally authorized to work in the United States (no sponsorship available). Familiarity with Webflow CMS and/or Framer for website building. Understanding of HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and accept feedback. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Eagerness to learn and adapt quickly in a professional setting.

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)

Prior experience or coursework in web development or digital design.

Exposure to SEO optimization, analytics integration, or schema markup. Familiarity with design tools such as Figma or Adobe Creative Suite.
• Experience working on projects for small businesses, nonprofits, or government contracts.

Drug Free Workplace

Uniqcli is a Drug Free Workplace. Post-offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria are met as outlined in company policy.

Pay & Benefits

This is a part-time hourly role with flexible scheduling. Pay is based on experience and market considerations.

Benefits for part-time employees may include:

Paid training and mentorship opportunities

Access to Uniqcli’s professional development resources
• Flexible work hours and remote work eligibility

Export Control Requirements

This is not an Export Control position.

Education

High school diploma or equivalent required. Coursework or certifications in Web Development, Computer Science, or Design are a plus.

Relocation

Relocation assistance is not provided for this position.

Visa Sponsorship

Uniqcli does not sponsor employment visas for this role. Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Shift

This position is for part-time work; scheduling is flexible and will be coordinated with the hiring manager.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Uniqcli LLC (Uniqcli) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

This position is temporarily remote.
